I personally think Mesaana's death was not Graendal's fault. It is true that she had the Dreamspike to use as she saw fit, but it was Perrin who took the ter'angreal to Tar Valon. Why would he choose Tar Valon of all places I do not know. Or maybe he was just passing by on his way to Dragonmount. 

Brandon Sanderson wanted to write more about Perrin, he actually did, and this part included Perrin in the Ways. Possibly Sammael's lookalike was someone using the Mask of Mirrors.
